meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: 把成果物套用 Anthropic 官方配色与字体：标题用 Poppins，正文用 Lora；文字颜色随背景自动调整，非文字图形用橙蓝绿品牌点缀色。
howto.when: 当你要处理带视觉样式的成果物（如幻灯片、文档、图表等），且要求品牌配色、视觉格式化或公司设计规范时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份幻灯片改成 Anthropic 官方品牌风格。
say.note: 会套用品牌配色和 Poppins/Lora 字体。

say.text: 把这段标题设成 Poppins，正文设成 Lora，背景用深色。
say.note: 应用对应字体，并让文字适配深色背景。

say.text: 给这些图形加上品牌橙、蓝、绿点缀色。
say.note: 非文字图形会轮流使用这几个品牌色。

howto.what_en: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to artifacts: Poppins for headings, Lora for body; text color adapts to background, and non-text graphics receive orange/blue/green accents.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request brand styling, visual formatting, or company design standards for any visual artifact needing Anthropic's look-and-feel.

say_en.text: Please restyle this slide deck using Anthropic's official brand look.
say_en.note: Applies brand palette and Poppins/Lora fonts.

say_en.text: Make this heading Poppins, body Lora, and use a dark background.
say_en.note: Sets fonts and adapts text color for dark bg.

say_en.text: Add Anthropic's orange, blue, and green accents to these shapes.
say_en.note: Cycles accent colors on non-text shapes.
